title: A/P Detail: the sort stays while changing date, scrolling and filters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop works at two locations with many open bills, and you sort A/P Detail, then change dates, scroll and filter.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • The report has open documents at both locations on today's and yesterday's date, with more than 100 lines in at least one bucket.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has open documents at both locations.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-33 Kept Sort.
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open Balance" header once.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  3. Expand the largest bucket.
  4. Scroll down inside it until more lines load.
  5. Open the Vendor filter.
  6. Tick {Vendor-A}.
  7. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the rows sort by Open Balance, largest first, and the header shows it.
  • Step 2: the report reloads for yesterday and is still sorted by Open Balance, largest first.
  • Step 3: the bucket opens and shows its rows.
  • Step 4: the new rows are still sorted by Open Balance, largest first.
  • Step 5: the Vendor menu opens.
  • Step 6: only {Vendor-A}'s rows remain (expand a group to see them: a filter change collapses every group), still sorted by Open Balance, largest first.
  • Step 7: only {Location-A} rows remain (expand a group to see them: a filter change collapses every group), still sorted by Open Balance, largest first, and "Open Balance" is still marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R7: “The sort is kept while the user stays on the report: changing the as-of date, loading more rows by scrolling, and changing the customer, vendor, Past due or Location filter keep it.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
